reviews.author: Darrick J. Wong
reviews.summary: Identified no major issues with the patch, expressed enthusiasm for its performance benefits, and offered to review the rest of the series.

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new callback, ->iomap_next(), which replaces the existing ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() callbacks in the iomap API. The goal is to improve performance by allowing callers to inline their iteration loop and pass ->iomap_next() as a compile-time constant.
